thread:
marta: quick ping — can someone review my PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3921. Adds a trace dashboard rollup + a small metrics exporter change. Hoping to merge in today's 4pm merge window. CI was flaky earlier but I bumped a timeout.

kevin: I'll take a look. Quick q: any ingestion schema changes or is this tag-only?

marta: no TSDB schema changes — just tags and an aggregation pipeline. Rollback plan is feature-flag based (feature: `trace-dashboard-v2`) — toggle in config-service. I added a migration script and a revert note in the PR.

lia: tagging @kevin — I'll review the prometheus rules and alert tweaks in ~30m.

samir: fyi CI job `integration-metrics` has been timing out for some runs today (kafka consumer stalls). If it's flaky we might need to increase the test timeout or mock the consumer.

marta: good catch — I bumped the kafka consumer test timeout to 45s in the branch and re-reran locally. tests pass locally now.

toni: tiny request — can you add a changelog entry under docs/observability/changes.md? QA needs a human-readable note for dashboard changes.

marta: done, pushed a short entry in docs/observability/changes.md in the same branch.

deploy-bot: Reminder — merge window opens 2026-03-17T16:00:00-07:00. Merges after that will be included in the 16:30 deploy. :bell:

kevin: quick code question — in metrics_exporter.go you changed `EmitSeries` signature. Is that backward compatible?

marta: it's additive. old call sites still compile; added tests for both flows. snippet in the PR:
```go
func EmitSeries(ctx context.Context, series []Series, tags map[string]string) error {
  // new tags param optional for backward compat
}
```

lia: LGTM for the prometheus rules, left one inline comment about label ordering (non-blocking).

samir: I can merge once kevin approves and CI is green. @marta please rebase if CI flakes again.

marta: rebased onto main, added one small unit test, CI queued. thanks all :rocket:

kevin: approved. :thumbsup: merge during the 4pm window.
